name: TwitterScore
summary: Influence scores for X (Twitter) accounts, mostly crypto: score history, smart followers by category and tag, mentions and trending accounts.

api_key.description: A TwitterScore API key, sent as the api_key query parameter.

notes: The docs give each call only as a URL with a query string (no method is stated); they are plain GETs.
Any call that takes an account accepts either username or twitter_id.
Request limits depend on the subscription plan; twitterscore.limits reports what is left.

endpoints.name: Get an account's TwitterScore
endpoints.summary: Username, X id and TwitterScore for one account.

twitter_id.description: X account id (from get_twitter_score); either this or username.

username.description: X username; either this or twitter_id.

endpoints.name: Check scores in bulk
endpoints.summary: Id, username, URL and score for several accounts.
notes: The docs do not state how several ids are separated in ids.

endpoints.name: Get account info
endpoints.summary: Username, name, bio, follower count and avatar link.

twitter_id.description: X account id (from get_twitter_score); either this or username.

username.description: X username; either this or twitter_id.

endpoints.name: Get score change
endpoints.summary: How much the score changed over the last week and month.

twitter_id.description: X account id (from get_twitter_score); either this or username.

username.description: X username; either this or twitter_id.

endpoints.name: Get follower count history

twitter_id.description: X account id (from get_twitter_score); either this or username.

username.description: X username; either this or twitter_id.

period.description: Window: 3, 7, 30, 180, 360 days or all; default 30 days.

notes: The docs list 3/7/30/180/360/all days but their own example sends period=1w; check the answer for the window used.

endpoints.name: List followers sorted by score
endpoints.summary: An account's followers, highest TwitterScore first, optionally filtered.

twitter_id.description: X account id (from get_twitter_score); either this or username.

username.description: X username; either this or twitter_id.

category_id.description: Only followers in this category (ids from get_categories).

tag_id.description: Only followers with this tag (ids from get_tags).

tag_category_id.description: Only followers in this tag category.

endpoints.name: Count followers per category
endpoints.summary: Number of an account's followers in each category.

twitter_id.description: X account id (from get_twitter_score); either this or username.

username.description: X username; either this or twitter_id.

endpoints.name: Get an account's smart mentions feed
endpoints.summary: Paginated tweets mentioning the account, with engagement and author scores.

twitter_id.description: X account id (from get_twitter_score); either this or username.

username.description: X username; either this or twitter_id.

endpoints.name: Get trending accounts
endpoints.summary: Accounts trending over the selected period with follower and score deltas.
notes: The period (3, 7 or 30 days) is selectable but its parameter name is not documented, so the default applies.

endpoints.name: Check API limits
endpoints.summary: Usage stats of the API subscription.
